# PulseBar 1.8.0
## What's changed
- A clearer bottom navigation for Overview, Apps, Events, and Settings. - A simpler disk image with just the app and Applications folder shortcut, displayed as two large icons. - A 2-second default refresh interval and English listed above Simplified Chinese in the language menu. - A consistent detail width and atomic navigation to prevent flicker when switching views. - Native dropdown menus remain open without dismissing the monitoring panel. - A More menu for updates, Reset, and Quit, plus a right-click menu on the menu bar readings. - Subtle opening, detail reveal, button feedback, and event expansion animations that respect Reduce Motion. - Grouped settings, direct CPU/Memory tabs in Apps, and a compact detail layout for narrow displays. - Escape returns from details to Overview, then closes the panel. Command-1 through Command-4 select the main destinations.
Requires macOS 13 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel. Preferences, monitoring behavior, and local event history are preserved.
